categories.main_business_segments: Xinxiang Richful New Material Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the fine chemical materials sector, focusing on the research, production, and sales of lubricant additives and carbonless paper color developers. The company produces single additives and composite additives for various applications including automotive engines, industrial oils, marine oils, and lubricating greases. Additionally, it supplies carbonless paper color developers used in multi-part forms such as invoices and receipts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced chemical synthesis and formulation technologies for lubricant additives, including proprietary processes for producing metal detergents, dispersants, antioxidants, and composite additives. It has established multiple laboratories and a pilot plant for R&D and quality control, and utilizes engine bench tests and vehicle road tests to validate product performance. The firm also produces carbonless paper color developers using innovative resin polymerization techniques, holding numerous domestic and international patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include lubricant oil manufacturers, automotive OEMs, industrial equipment producers, and paper product manufacturers. The company serves both domestic and international markets, supplying major lubricant producers and expanding its presence with OEM certifications. Its products cater to sectors such as automotive, aerospace, railways, marine, industrial machinery, and paper manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Xinxiang and subsidiaries across various regions including Shanghai, Shenzhen, and overseas locations such as Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, Belgium, and the United States. It has established overseas warehouses and sales networks to serve global customers, particularly in Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: Richful New Material operates mainly in the midstream segment of the lubricant additive supply chain, producing chemical additives that are essential components for lubricant oil manufacturers downstream. It also extends upstream by producing some key raw materials internally to ensure supply security and quality control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in environmentally friendly, high-efficiency lubricant additives, focusing on transitioning from single additives to composite additives with higher performance levels. It invests heavily in R&D, aiming for advanced product certifications such as API and OEM approvals. Strategic R&D projects include developing additives meeting ACEA C3, GF-7, and China VI emission standards, as well as expanding into special industrial oils and viscosity modifiers. The firm also plans to build a lubricant additive research institute to enhance its technological capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of lubricant additives and carbonless paper color developers. The company employs a direct sales model with customized product offerings and pricing strategies based on production costs, raw material prices, market demand, and customer negotiations. It also derives income from investment returns and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global lubricant additive market is dominated by four major international companies: Lubrizol, Infineum, Chevron Oronite, and Afton, controlling about 85% of the market. Richful New Material positions itself as a leading domestic supplier with growing international influence, focusing on import substitution and expanding its market share through technological innovation and OEM certifications. It is the first A-share listed company in the domestic lubricant additive sector and actively competes by enhancing product quality and expanding composite additive offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.16 billion, a 12.14% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 722 million, up 19.13%. It maintains a strong asset base with total assets exceeding RMB 4.3 billion and equity of RMB 3.34 billion. The company has shown steady growth in sales volume and revenue, particularly in composite additives, which now account for over 60% of revenue. It continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D to sustain growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Richful New Material offers high-quality, environmentally friendly lubricant additives with stable performance and competitive pricing. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes a full range of single additives and advanced composite additives certified by international standards and OEMs. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, proprietary technologies, extensive patent holdings, and a global marketing network, enabling it to meet diverse customer needs and support global supply chain security.
